tasks.Initial Inventory Calculation: Given the initial inventory of golf balls at the beginning of the day is 600.
tasks.Percentage Sold Calculation: Calculate 80% of the initial inventory to determine how many golf balls were sold by the end of the day.
tasks.White Balls Sold Calculation: Since all white golf balls were sold and an equal number of yellow and white golf balls were sold, find out how many white golf balls (and thus yellow golf balls) were sold.
tasks.Yellow Balls Initial Inventory Calculati: Subtract the number of white golf balls sold from the total number of golf balls sold to find the initial inventory of yellow golf balls.
